listing.name: Domain Phase Lab
listing.summary: Adds a new high-tech faction with a deep story campaign, experimental weapons, and unique ships focused on phase space and energy-based combat.

description:
Click on the banner or image to download.

The mod is still in development. Any feedback and bug reports are greatly appreciated.

Introduction

A story about the fate of a domain military scientific institute studying phase space in the burning sector.The Domain Phase Lab is a

High-Tech

faction centered around beam weaponry, lightning, motes, and surprisingly, phase technology.The mod focuses on

story content

revolving around the faction. There are several quests that rewards the players with

limited experimental weaponry and ships.

The Phase Labs are by nature pacifists who are more than eager to get to know others better.

Ships

Ships

Note: Only a few of the many ships are being shown. Ships are still subject to change.

DPL's ship designs mainly focuses around high-tech ships with a heavy focus towards energy weapons, as well as carriers to provide long-range support. Naturally, the Phase Labs also offers a wide variety of Phase Ships, some of which employs the use of certain gimmicks rather than providing any firepower themselves.

That said, the faction does not mainly rely on Phase Ships. The Phase Labs pursue the field of study of the many properties of P-Space, and their research bears fruit in the forms of weapons and systems.[close]

Weapons

Weapons

The Bombardon

(Built-in weapon for the Sarrusophone-class Capital), a long-range 'sniper' railgun.

The Phase Charge Lance

, a common large beam weapon that creates motes upon impact.

The Lightning Projector

, shoot powerful arcs of EMP lightning with rechargable ammo!

The Phase Rupture LPC

, manipulate literal P-Space Phenomena as your tools of war.

...There are even some powerful prototype hulls and weapons out there, but they won't be so easy to obtain...

[close]

ChangelogNew MAJOR update 1.7.0!1.7.2
  • Minor Update
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where Camilla wrongly says the special hullmod costs 10/15 OP for cruisers/capitals while this hullmod actually needs 25/35 OP.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the scan options for the quest "Invention" from Ross wouldn't trigger correctly when players visit the stars. Now the quest would ask the players to visit any planet that orbits a star of the specific type, and the scan option will always trigger.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where Jingle and Nova Blaster are available on markets. But this fix wouldn't work unless we start a new save.
  • Crisis Adjustment: Now the crisis wouldn't trigger if Muspelheim system doesn't spawn. The crisis also wouldn't trigger unless you have heavy industry on a planet of size 4 or above, AND you also have a colony item installed on that heavy industry. This should make the crisis in general a bit less intense.
  • Ship Adjustment: Adjusted the sprite for the ship "Nightmare" and changed the weapon slots accordingly.

1.7.1
  • Minor Update
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where some of the test missions are still present in the menu mission list.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where some ship systems have wrong descriptions.
  • Adjusted the ship 'Sousaphone'. Now even if it uses its skill at 0 flux level, it still receives some benefits instead of none.
  • Adjusted the DPL station. Now it shouldn't be too strong, and it's also more fragile.

1.7.0
Major Update
Balance
  • Rebalanced the vast majority of weapons, to be more or less on-par with vanilla.
  • Reworked weapons that previously had 'shield-piercing' effects to new designs that don't break the game's balance.
  • The Energy missiles (previously literal blue reapers) have been changed into a Salamander-like volley burst, instead of a single-hit weapon with massive strength that was too good at both breaking shields and armor.
  • Adjusted the stats of the vast majority of ships to more closely resemble vanilla High-Tech. In general, DPL ships should now be more well-rounded and sturdier to endure some degree of punishment.
  • Reworked the systems of many ships.
  • Removed the built-in hullmods of the vast majority of ships that had them.
  • Fighter spam in DPL is no longer as broken, with reduced fighter bays and balanced fighter LPCs.
  • Removed Phase Carrier ships, instead replacing their design as a whole into specialized 'Anomaly' carrier ships.
  • DPL ships that were underperforming now have more weapon mount variety, instead of being mono-energy.

Graphics
  • DPL ships now have their own color scheme instead of looking like blue high-tech.
  • Reworked the design of many ships in general.
  • Reworked some of the weapons' visuals.
  • Added a new icon for Matcha.

Campaign
  • Revised the notoriously bad writing (Proofreader: Akii), alongside some new dialogue additions and changes in certain missions. The writing as a whole is still a work in progress.
  • Reworked Colony Crisis to be more concise and reasonable.
  • Temporarily removed 2 ships: Cornet, Whisper.
  • Changes to story quests, such as the removal of time limits, to prevent the player from getting softlocked in their progress.
  • Adjusted faction's music volume to not be as loud.
  • Eliza and Ross are now slightly less heartfeltly touched by the player asking them about how was their day.
  • Overall bug fixes and improvements.

1.6.8
  • Minor Update
  • Music Adjustment: Major rewrites/refinements and adjustments to all back ground musics.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that jams the Light Meets Dark quest.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that the Justice and Celebration quests could fail before the boss fleet reaches the planet.
  • Adjusted the ship 'Phase Lab Onslaught'. Now it doesn't have Heavy Ballistic Integration, and its armor is reduced to 1500 instead of 1600. But it has 20000 flux instead of 18000, and 900 dissipation instead of 800.

1.6.75
  • Minor Update
  • Music Adjustment: Made some adjustments to neutral & friendly market background musics.

1.6.7
  • Minor Update
  • Added new market and fleet encounter musics to the Phase Lab faction.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug in the settings.json file.

1.6.6
  • Minor Update
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that a .ship file doesn't exist.

1.6.5
  • Major Update
  • Game Mechanics Change: Added 6 new main quests (series) for Ross.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Now Revenge is a story mission and will never fail. You can finish it and meet Ross under most situations.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Added a feature that some of the special officers (from this mod) may leave upon Sat Bomb. But you can dismiss them and then recruit them back later.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Added 1 new recruitable officer: Greater Kapteyn.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Major rewrites to some main quests, and the opening scene when you meet Eliza.
  • Added 1 new ship that can be salvaged during a new quest.
  • Mission Adjustment: Added more enemy in the mission 'It Takes One', and added another friendly ship in the mission 'For Science'.
  • Icon Change: Refined the icon for Matcha.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that prevents Eliza from being randomly located during her final quest.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that a quest-related special ship would randomly show up.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that some test weapons will randomly spawn. My apologies here :-[.
  • Buffed the weapon 'Song of Light'. Now it has a base range of 700 instead of 600, its secondary arcs have 30% of its range instead of 20%.
  • Buffed the weapon 'Song of Chaos'. Now it has special damage effect per arc of 4.5% of armor and 0.45% of hull instead of 3.5% of armor and 0.35% of hull.
  • Adjusted the weapon 'Song of Dimension'. Now it deals 100% of real damage instead of 30%, but its damage is 120 instead of 200.
  • Adjusted the ship 'Trombone'. Now its ship system is manuvering jets instead of reserved wings, but its DP is 24 instead of 25.

1.6.3
  • Minor Update
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that causes a crush when starting new games.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Made some more refinements to the writings of the colony crisis.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Now if you really sell your planet in the colony crisis, you can trade with it.

1.6.2
  • Minor Update
  • Inter Mod Supports: Now Domain Phase Lab supports the version checker feature in Nexerelin and LunaLib. Though the version history has a small amount of display flaws.
  • Mission Adjustment: Rewrote all the mission Texts for the main menu missions. They are now more readable and also closer to vanilla stories.
  • Game Mechanics Adjustment: Refined the stories for the colony crisis. They are now more readable and also closer to vanilla writing style.
  • Game Mechanics Adjustment: Now Ross has some new chatty stuffs. You can ask her different questions at different relation level just like Eliza.
  • Campaign Mission Adjustment: Refined the writings for some of the campaign missions, now they are closer to the lore.
  • Ship Adjustment: Changed the ship sprites of the ship 'Flumpet'.
  • Ship Adjustment: Nerfed the ship 'Trombone'. Now it takes 25 DP instead of 24.
  • Wing Adjustment: Nerfed the wing 'Agolo'. Now it costs 18 OP instead of 15, has 250 flux capacity instead of 300, and takes 6 seconds to reborn instead of 5.
  • Weapon Adjustment: Adjusted the weapon 'Lightning Projector'. Now it takes 6 seconds to refire instead of 2. But its range is 750 instead of 650.
  • Weapon Adjustment: Adjusted the weapon 'Heavy Lightning Projector'. Now it takes 3 seconds to refire instead of 2. But its range is 750 instead of 700.
  • Weapon Adjustment: Adjusted the weapon 'Song of Time'. Now it causes 3000 damage instead of 1000, its special effect causes 100% real damage instead of 300%, and this special effect can only be triggered if the projectile hits on hull, hitting on shields now only generates lightning arcs dealing 25% of its damage.
  • Hullmod Adjustment: Nerfed the hullmod 'Logistic Center'. Now it takes 25 OP for cruisers and 35 OP for capitals.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that randomly spawns in-dev weapons for new quest-related challenges everywhere.

1.6.1
  • Minor Update
  • Ship Adjustment: Minor changes to the built-in weapon sprites and ship sprites to the ship 'Phase Lab Onslaught'.

1.6.0
  • Major Update
  • Game Mechanics Change: Added a new main quest (series), new special scene, and two new outlooks for Eliza that can be unlocked by completing this new quest.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Adjusted the fleet points for the quest-critical enemy ships so that the quest fleets will not be killed by other random campaign fleets.
  • Game Mechanics Change: Added new story-critical planets protections. These can be turned off by editing the settings.json file for this mod.
